⭐ NEXT CODE AT 5,000 LIKES 👍

🧟 Welcome to Undead RNG 🎲
It’s a survival RNG game about Rolling, Shooting, and Surviving. Roll 100+ weapons with unique rarities and augments, creating over 100T+ combinations. Build your arsenal, fight hordes of zombies, and survive!

⚠️ [Beta Release]
The game is under active development. If you find bugs or have suggestions, tell us in the official server!

❓ [How To Play]
• Roll for weapons
• Sell weapons for Cash
• Kill zombies for XP and level up
• Return between waves to sell, upgrade and ROLL AGAIN

[Chat Commands]
•  /safezone - teleport back to the safezone
• /ff - vote to surrender the round
• /rtv - vote to change the map next wave

Join the group for a free gift!
CODES: 20KMEMBERS, 30KMEMBERS, 1KLIKES, UPDATE5, 2KLIKES, HORDEMODE, 3KLIKES
